description: A direct field write `@dateRange.start = 20` under `invariant (start <= end)` (end 10) is checked at run time on the candidate value and traps (E-WRITE-INVARIANT-RT) before the write: start stays 0 and the handler's next statement never runs (n stays 0).
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md-S483-struct-invariant-syntax ("yes, your recommendations on all three plus the follow-up"); ruling:user-voice-scrml.md-S482-struct-invariant-contract ("RULED yes (a)")
rationale: §66.13.5 "When it is checked": every write that changes a field in the read set is checked on the candidate value before anything is written; rule 10: any other write is checked at run time and a violation is the E-WRITE-INVARIANT-RT trap, raised before the write; ruling S483 item 2: "otherwise the E-WRITE-INVARIANT-RT trap before any write (S477)".
